html:
Build a singly linked list and find its middle using slow and fast pointers. For even lengths return the later middle value. [] returns None.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      7,
      8,
      9,
      10
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 9
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      1,
      2,
      3
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 2
}
Hint

Move one pointer twice as quickly.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(n) allocated nodes
